name: aquatech-blade-x-ability-1-pays-its-printed-cost
notes: AquaTech Blade X, ability 1: the printed activation cost (REST, Banish/Sacrifice CARDNAME, (N), extra costs) used to be unpaid, so the ability ran for free and repeatedly. Activated here in a generic environment (Guo Jia level-3 champion with the card's class, allies, Powercell, graveyard and memory cards, a Bow, six hand cards of reserve fuel); the assertions pin the cost that is now paid. Costs live in GAFieldAbilityCostTable() (Custom/GameLogic.php).

rulesClauses: Printed activation cost of AquaTech Blade X ability 1

engineBug.summary: AquaTech Blade X ability 1 never paid its printed activation cost (it ran free and could be repeated).
